data.name: App.ProductName
data.comment: The product name. INVARIANT: the same word in every language; it must never come back translated.

data.name: Product.Framework
data.comment: A third-party product name. INVARIANT - a trademark is not translated.

data.name: Format.CustomerCode
data.comment: The literal shape of a customer code, shown in help text. INVARIANT - it is the rule itself, not a description of it.

data.name: App.Title
data.comment: Application bar title. Keep the product name; translate what follows the dash.

data.name: Dashboard.Title
data.comment: Heading of the main area. A noun phrase - the desk that serves customers.

data.name: Dashboard.WelcomeBack
data.comment: Greeting under the heading. {0} is the signed-in user's display name; some languages inflect the greeting for the person's gender - Ana is a woman.

data.name: Dashboard.Language
data.comment: Caption beside the language picker. A noun.

data.name: User.DisplayName
data.comment: The signed-in user's given name as this session's language writes it. A transliteration, not a translation.

data.name: Rail.Culture
data.comment: Heading over the culture information in the side rail. The .NET sense of the word - language plus regional formatting - not culture as in the arts.

data.name: Culture.Neutral
data.comment: Shown beside the culture name when the session is reading the neutral resource file rather than a translated one. Lower case; it follows a middot.

data.name: Culture.Untranslated
data.comment: Developer report in the side rail. {0} is a count of resource keys whose value under this culture is still the neutral one - either untranslated, or legitimately the same word. Keep it short.

data.name: Nav.Customers
data.comment: Navigation entry. A noun, plural.

data.name: Nav.Tickets
data.comment: Navigation entry. Support tickets, not travel tickets.

data.name: Preview.Title
data.comment: Heading over the three values the session's culture formatted.

data.name: Preview.Date
data.comment: Caption of the formatted date tile.

data.name: Preview.Count
data.comment: Caption of the formatted number tile. A count of units, not a size.

data.name: Preview.Amount
data.comment: Caption of the formatted currency tile. A sum of money.

data.name: Ticket.Open
data.comment: A ticket STATE, not the verb: a ticket that is currently open. Adjective.

data.name: Ticket.Closed
data.comment: A ticket state: work finished. Adjective.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Open
data.comment: Button caption: the imperative VERB - open the selected customer. Not the state Ticket.Open. Many languages use two different words; this is the one the reviewer has to be told about.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Name
data.comment: Label of the customer name field.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Email
data.comment: Label of the email address field.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Save
data.comment: Primary button caption. The imperative verb, not the noun.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Cancel
data.comment: Button caption. Discards the edit; the imperative verb.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Saved
data.comment: Confirmation after a successful save. One whole sentence.

data.name: Customer.LastOrder
data.comment: One whole line. {0} is the ORDER NUMBER and {1} the order DATE, already formatted for the reader. Both placeholders must appear and must not be swapped - a machine draft got this wrong once.

data.name: Validation.Required
data.comment: Validation message, one whole sentence.

data.name: Validation.Email
data.comment: Validation message when the address does not parse. One whole sentence, imperative.

data.name: Language.en-US
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. INVARIANT: a language list shows every language in its own language.

data.name: Language.de-DE
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. INVARIANT - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.it-IT
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. INVARIANT - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.fr-CA
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. INVARIANT - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.ar-SA
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. INVARIANT - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.qps-ploc
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. A test locale, not a language. INVARIANT.

data.name: Status.Direction
data.comment: Status strip. {0} is a culture name and is never translated; {1} is Direction.Ltr or Direction.Rtl.

data.name: Direction.Ltr
data.comment: Reading direction, lower case, used inside Status.Direction.

data.name: Direction.Rtl
data.comment: Reading direction, lower case, used inside Status.Direction.
